_doc: Declared before any run. Each stage is judged on its own; there is no blended score.

candidate_retrieval.recall_definition: per query, the best alternative relevant set: |set & top-k| / |set|; macro mean over queries with relevant entries
candidate_retrieval.precision_definition: per query, relevant candidates / candidates returned (at most k; the diary drops candidates under min_score); macro mean

context_load.recall_definition: best alternative relevant set: |set & loaded context| / |set|; macro mean

answer.verdict: needs-judge: deterministic signals are provisional; a judge applies rubric.json to every row
